title: Audit explicit currency/date consistency and indicative FX
reason:
User payments specify amount,currency and date; AdventureWorks Currency/CurrencyRate specify pair and date. Proposed currency validity intervals and same-date ECB quotes can expose withdrawn codes or compare fixture rates with indicative reference rates. Derive USD crossrates only with explicit quote orientation and shared publication date. Visuals: validity timeline,rate ratio chart,missing-rate grid. AW DEM/FRF during2022–2025 are source conflicts,not accepted matches. SIX withdrawal month differs from CLDR tender interval; rights and rate semantics unresolved. No other demo receives an invented currency.

Phase 2 context reviewed: scenario; directly attached assertion dispositions are enumerated in p2-coverage.json. Member/dependency IDs preserved. Each unresolved/rejected mapping, source rights and temporal/domain gap remains a readiness prerequisite; no portfolio selection or executable bundle acceptance. 

Root accepted reviewed FX readiness on 2026-10-05: prioritize bounded fresh FX reconciliation after the current W1 gate, then decide a small indicative reference lookup packet. Current W1 scope and W2-W7 candidates remain preserved. No selected, implemented, publishable or live claim. Faithful canonical ECB custom source-data terms/provenance, actual publisher validation and registry/Directory acceptance remain an open gate; no standard SPDX substitute or existing compliant publication path is asserted. Source quote acceptance is unchanged; AW/current-reference and currency-validity reconciliation and actual browser acceptance remain required.
practical_value: Proposed connected bundle; identity, temporal, legal and match-rate review required. Not selected or implemented.
showcase_value: Named visualisations support the questions; practical joinability dominates.
